# Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty

> > Independent news organization providing journalism on Russia, Iran, Ukraine, Central Asia, and countries where free press is banned or not fully established.

RFE/RL delivers comprehensive coverage of geopolitical conflicts, democratic transitions, and human rights issues across Eastern Europe, Central Asia, and the Middle East. Broadcasting from Prague, the organization reports on critical developments involving Russia, Iran, China, and former Soviet states.

## Key Topics

- Russia and Kremlin politics
- Iran relations and conflicts
- Ukraine-Russia war
- US foreign policy
- Georgia and Caucasus region
- Belarus and authoritarian regimes
- China censorship and media control
- Presidential elections and democracy
- Middle East geopolitics
- Military capabilities and defense
- Soviet Union legacy states
- Nuclear diplomacy
- Human rights and refugees
- Trade sanctions and economic policy

## Russia and Former Soviet States

- [Russia: Five Myths About The Elections](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051041.html): Analysis debunking myths about Russia's 2007 election process
- [Belarus: U.S. Embassy Cuts Staff Amid Diplomatic Row](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051047.html): US-Belarus diplomatic crisis forces embassy staff reduction in Minsk
- [Belarus: European Commission Threatens Trade Sanctions](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051099.html): EU threatens Belarus with trade sanctions over labor rights violations
- [CIS: New World Bank Report Shows Mixed Progress On Poverty](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051049.html): World Bank report on poverty and inequality in CIS countries
- [Abkhazia: President, Opposition Trade Accusations](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051036.html): Abkhazia election interference accusations ahead of parliamentary vote

## Middle East and Iran

- [Militaries By The Numbers: Iran And Israel](https://www.rferl.org/a/1002744/1/32912289.html): Military comparison of Iran and Israel capabilities and technology
- [Aftershocks Continue To Rock Bam As Agencies Try To Help Iran Quake Survivors](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051051.html): Bam earthquake aftermath with humanitarian relief efforts in Iran

## Caucasus and Georgia

- [Saakashvili Claims Victory In Georgian Presidential Election](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051056.html): Saakashvili declares victory in Georgia's 2004 presidential election
- [Georgia: Saakashvili Faces No Serious Opposition In Presidential Vote](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051063.html): Saakashvili's unopposed run following Rose Revolution in Georgia

## Asia-Pacific and Global Affairs

- [China: Acting To Keep Out 'Harmful Information'](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051037.html): China's media censorship and foreign investment restrictions under Hu Jintao
- [North Korea: U.S. Delegation Begins Visit Following 'Bold' Concession To Washington](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051091.html): US experts visit Yongbyon nuclear complex amid North Korea negotiations
- [South Asia: Talks In Islamabad Raise Hopes Of Progress On Kashmir](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051080.html): India-Pakistan Kashmir peace talks between Vajpayee and Musharraf
- [Afghanistan/Iraq: Immigrants Discover That Australia Offers No Warm Welcome](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051087.html): Australia's detention of Afghan and Iraqi asylum seekers and refugees

## Optional

- [Week in Russia Region Widget-GR-1878](https://www.rferl.org/a/1042340/1/31157751.html): Newsletter signup widget for Russia coverage by Steve Gutterman
- [U.S.: 'Stardust' Mission Grabs A Comet By Its Tail And Heads Back To Earth](https://www.rferl.org/a/1051097.html): NASA Stardust spacecraft collects first comet samples from Wild-2
